arithmetic: FP32 stored matrix/features/probabilities; FP64 ordered norm,dot,exp and sums. Native toolchain and original flags bound. Same-host exact repeats required; real-arithmetic projected-gradient interpretation is not a finite-code size guarantee.
control: P emits native probabilities, no matrix updates. K trains the aligned shadow matrix but emits native probabilities. D emits aligned adapted probabilities. S trains with (truth+1)%205 while preserving feature sequence, capacity and update schedule.
decision_policy: Valid g_P<=0 or g_S<=0 rejects this one fixed development realization. Positive predictive result receives no automatic confirmation or scale; delivery costs remain separately charged. Correctness/control/resource failure invalidates affected inference. No parameter rescue within this run.
initialization: Unchanged native cold start and dictionary pretraining; zero delayed histories and fixed posterior prior.
mechanism: Projected online multinomial head on frozen192dimensional transformer features. Matrix205x192 starts atzero and resets at original piece boundaries. phi=xn/sqrt(1+sum(xn^2)). q=softmax(capped_base_logits+Aphi). First prediction after reset preserves native base probabilities exactly. Update A+=0.25*(onehot(truth)-q)*phi^T; project Frobenius norm to3.999999 when norm exceeds4. All observations are decoded tokens, including piece-final tokens; PPM-only first tokens have no pending head prediction.
state: Every weight,previousfeature,pendingdistribution,five counters and pending flag at2048decodedbytes andtermination. Every frozen hidden vector and post-softcap logit covered by SHA256blocks of1024predictions. P/K original coder/archive identity. K/D introduced-state identity. All arms frozen deep-feature/base-logit digests equal; downstream CMIX states may differ under D/S.
